solutions.title: Scan each window
solutions.strategy: Compute each window maximum by scanning its k elements.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are n-k+1 windows and each scan can inspect k values.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the output and loop counters are stored.

solutions.title: Monotonic deque
solutions.strategy: Keep candidate indices in decreasing value order and remove indices that leave the window.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each index is inserted and removed at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The deque stores at most k window indices.
